proposals.before: An edict ordered the Masters of Writing to arrest the Jia kin; the Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, attendants, Yellow Gate Gentlemen, and the Eight Seats were all summoned into the hall at night.
proposals.after: An edict ordered the Masters of Writing to arrest the Jia kin; the Secretariat Supervisor, attendants, Yellow Gate Gentlemen, and the Eight Seats were all summoned into the hall at night.
proposals.reason: 中書監 is the Secretariat Supervisor, a different office from 中書令 (Secretariat Director). The current Masters of Writing wording incorrectly identifies the institution. Correct this office alone; keep the preceding 尚書 (Masters of Writing), other summoned offices and their actions unchanged.

proposals.before: Chancellor Lun arrested the Prince of Wu Yan, younger brother of the Prince of Huainan's mother, intending to kill him.
proposals.after: Chancellor Lun arrested the Prince of Wu Yan, the Prince of Huainan's younger brother by the same mother, intending to kill him.
proposals.reason: 淮南王母弟吳王晏 identifies Yan, Prince of Wu, as the Prince of Huainan Yun’s younger brother by the same mother. 母弟 is a maternal/full brother designation here, not the mother’s younger brother. Preserve the shared-mother qualifier without asserting an additional paternal relationship, and retain Lun’s arrest and intention to kill.
